scope: Staged four-owner effect jobs; not seven-kind completion or runtime activation

implemented.schema: 115-step source-bound additive lineage, preserving the preceding 109 steps. Exact attempt/generation receipts have real same-tenant workflow/screening/scoring/outbox FKs; deliveries reference receipt tenant/kind/id. Identity triggers and state/counter checks fail closed
implemented.producer: Explicit NewQueuedEffectStore requires all four copied queue policies. Effect, receipt and initial delivery batches share the authorized owner transaction. Any batch/enqueue failure poisons the queued transaction even if the caller ignores the returned batch error
implemented.identity: Only domain attempt 1 and redrive generation 0 are allocated/executed by this slice. The general seven-kind codec is not an arbitrary-attempt producer. Transport retry retains the exact owner identity
implemented.receipts: Permanent owner receipts deduplicate after transport deletion. No receipt sweep or redrive allocator exists. FK RESTRICT deliberately prevents orphaning receipts through owner deletion
implemented.worker_primitives: Separate mandatory tenant/kind/action worker authorizer; SKIP LOCKED claim, lease heartbeat and transactional finish. Resource -> receipt -> delivery lock order. Identity/token/transport attempt checked; final expiry predicate rolls back local effects. Shared River error-count retry policy and exhaustion code reused
implemented.external_delivery: No external call is made by the adapter. Outcome callbacks permit only short local SQL; receivers still need stable identity-based idempotency. No exactly-once external-effect claim
